chunks: Say: "No one can save me from God, nor can I find a place of refuge apart from Him,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that there is no refuge from God except Him?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Jinn, this verse underscores the Prophet Muhammad's absolute dependence on Allah, serving as a model for believers to seek refuge solely in the Divine rather than in created beings or intermediaries. It reinforces the concept of Tawhid by declaring that no entity, whether angel, jinn, or human, can avert God's decree or provide a sanctuary apart from Him, a theme deeply resonant in Shia theology regarding the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt being contingent upon God's will.
